title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-01-03
lineage: Master DAT > Panasonic SV-3700 > UA-5 > USB > WaveLab  Mastering in WaveLab with iZotope Ozone 4 > CD Wave > TLH > Flac

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture with solid quality showcases a strong early‑'70 performance highlighted by Cosmic Charlie, beautiful Wolf and a favorite Mason’s rendition.
ai_review.review: The show is praised as one of the best early‑1970 dates, delivering standout versions of Workingman's material, a smoking Cosmic Charlie, a beautiful Wolf, and an especially beloved take on Mason's. The soundboard source is generally solid with only minor “small cuts,” providing clear and enjoyable listening despite the unknown exact venue date.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers rate 4‑5 stars, emphasizing strong musical performance and overall solid soundboard quality with only minor technical quirks.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Overall solid soundboard capture; a few small cuts are noted but the mix remains clear and balanced throughout.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows well, delivering energetic Workingman's material early on and moving into memorable mid‑set highlights that keep the momentum high.
